portraits.era_note: Appearance interval 1991-01-01 to 1991-12-26 exclusive is accepted for illustration only, not office tenure or eligibility. Source date: 1991-10. Month only. The uploader Dmedvedev83's original upload (rev 794636807, 2023-08-20T12:45:33Z) gives |date=1991-10 and the description 'Moscow, October 1991' / 'Москва, октябрь 1991 года'. On 2025-07-09 a third-party editor, MasterRus21thCentury, changed the date to 1991-10-24 and the description to 'October 24 1991' (rev 1054800689, summary 'corr') without citing a source; the current extmetadata (DateTimeOriginal 1991-10-24) reflects that edit and is not used. An IP edit of 2025-01-26 to 1991-10-01 was reverted. EXIF DateTime 2023:08:20 is the scan date. Not independently corroborated. Registry birth date 1931-03-02. The photograph (October 1991, month precision) shows him at 60. It lies inside the requested window, about 9 to 10 months after its start (1991-01-01, age 59) and about 2 to 3 months before its exclusive end (1991-12-26, age 60), so no age adjustment is asked for; the prompt asks for a man of 59 to 60. Declared artistic extensions: the full standing body, hands, trousers and shoes (from a head-and-shoulders photograph) and all colours (the photograph is black and white). No historical holder, office boundary or chronology is changed.

The v2 preserves a lateral forehead birthmark arc, substantial downward lobe and separated flecks on his anatomical right/viewer-left, closer to the source than the narrow v1 patch. Color and standing body are artistic; mark shape is stylized rather than a photographic tracing.
